en: This database provides the digital surrogates of Sanskrit manuscripts stored in the general library of the University of Tokyo. The descrition of this collection is available on the Website of the Library (written in Japanese). This Web site is built and maintained by the Department of Indian Philosophy and Buddhist Studies, Graduate School of Humanities and Sociology, The University of Tokyo and The SAT Daizōkyō Database Committee with technical support from the International Institute for Digital Humanities. This project was funded by UTokyo Digital Archives Project (2020-2022), and KAKENHI JP15H05725, JP19H00516, JP23H00002, and JP23H03696.
The University of Tokyo and The SAT Daizōkyō Database Committee
